errors.evidence: The description states that the countries on the x-axis are sorted alphabetically by their codes, but they are actually sorted in ascending order of the total energy cost (the height of the bars).

The description assigns the color 'син' (blue) to the category 'Енергия за отопление'. According to the legend and the chart, this category corresponds to the light blue/teal color, while 'Електроенергия' corresponds to 'тъмносин' (dark blue). Assigning 'син' is ambiguous and potentially misleading, as it could be confused with the more prominent dark blue.
